stage2Update.note: Stage 2 delivers desktop authentication + session enforcement. Three trust layers: bootstrap channel (256-bit token per server lifecycle, constant-time verify, X-Horizon-Bootstrap-Token header), operator authentication (scrypt-versioned, composite rate limits, first-run setup only), application session (opaque tokens, 15min/7d/30d TTLs, family rotation on refresh with reuse-invalidation). Migration 0021 adds 5 additive tables. Renderer receives only SanitizedAuthState — no raw tokens, no hashes, no bootstrap token. authenticationRequired defaults to true in production.

changes.evidence: New apps/server/src/auth/{bootstrap,passwords,sessions,accounts,events,loginLimits,recovery}.ts modules; apps/server/src/routes/auth.ts (9 endpoints); apps/server/src/middleware/{bootstrapAuth,operatorSession}.ts; apps/desktop/src/main/{bootstrapToken,secureStorage,authenticatedApiClient,desktopAuthManager}.ts; apps/desktop/src/renderer/screens/AuthGate.tsx. 44 server tests + 27 desktop tests + 1 real end-to-end integration test all pass. Server refuses to boot in production without HORIZON_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.

requireBootstrapAuthorization gates every bootstrap-safe endpoint. observer-policy-versions and champion-configuration split into desktopOperatorRouter (requires bearer). loopback binding is now a secondary control only.
9 REST endpoints under /api/operator-auth (setup/login/refresh/logout/lock/change-password/revoke-all/session/state); rate-limited; scrypt-hashed credentials; opaque server-managed sessions.

Migration 0021 (additive) adds local_operator_accounts, operator_auth_sessions, operator_auth_events, operator_login_limits, operator_recovery_records. desktop_sessions (application-runtime scope) is NOT overloaded.
DesktopAuthManager owns tokens in the main process only; refresh persisted via keytar in packaged mode (SS4 test enforces no plaintext fallback). Renderer receives only SanitizedAuthState.
8 typed auth IPC channels with Zod schemas; SanitizedAuthState schema rejects raw token fields (regression guard I6/I8).

AuthGate.tsx renders correct screen per phase; protected screens only mount when phase=authenticated; every business IPC channel with requiresAuthenticatedSession=true is blocked when not authenticated.
